Hi! We're looking for someone to help in our bakery on weekends (Saturday and Sunday, 6am to 1pm). It's a small family place called Honeycomb Hearth Bakery on Main Street and we get super busy on weekend mornings!! You'd be serving customers at the counter, packing orders, making coffees and helping keep everything clean. No experience needed, we'll teach you everything, but you need to be friendly and not mind early mornings. FoodSafe would be great but isn't required. Pay is $17.85/hr plus tips. If you're interested just reply to this email with a bit about yourself or drop by and ask for Marisol. Thanks so much!!
